name: Modern
description: Dark dashboard in the style of recent pellet grill apps: big grill temperature, mode / target / Smoke+ controls, temperature chart, probe cards with targets and ETA, timer and output status. Designed for phones and for the 5" touch display.
author: Carmelo (cannos88)
attributions: Barlow typeface by Jeremy Tribby (SIL Open Font License)

config.name: chart_minutes
config.description: Minutes of history shown on the chart when the page opens (30, 90 or 180).

config.name: presets
config.description: Comma separated label:temperature pairs, in the grill units. Empty uses the defaults (90/110/180/230 °C).
